release_notes: Direct URL streams finally show clicks: a hop to a stream's Direct URL now counts as an offer click everywhere (reports, campaigns list, dashboard, CR/EPC), including past clicks of streams that use a Direct URL today. Streams keep their IDs when you save a campaign - before, every save re-created them, so the report grouped by stream fell apart into unnamed numbers. Old IDs read 'Deleted stream #N', unnamed live streams 'Unnamed stream', and new streams are named Stream 1, Stream 2... The Streams tab shows each stream's visits, unique visitors, bots and share of traffic for today / yesterday / 7 / 30 days. Report columns explain themselves in their tooltips. Logs: Load more on every tab, Export CSV (up to 100,000 rows), and the stream of each click with stream and date filters.
